section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining the psychometric properties of the Malay translation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in a community sample of 781 Malaysian Malay and Chinese adults. The study assessed the factor structure, invariance across sex and ethnicity, internal consistency, and validity of the BAS-2, finding a one-dimensional structure with adequate fit and evidence of construct and incremental validity.
